title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: redesigned navigation pane with longer chat history and quick create for Notebooks and agents
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview Graph automation for both Notebook creation policy and agent user access, contrary to the table's claims that neither has automation. The statement that configuration monitors cannot change these settings also overlooks their preview applyOnce mode; the roadmap facts and cited admin paths are supported.

claims.claim: No tenant UI or API control to keep the previous navigation layout is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot app 518222 navigation pane previous layout admin disable rollback default quick actions Notebook Agent Builder. Opened configure-copilot-admin-center and copilotPolicySetting; neither documents a previous-layout switch.

claims.quote: App feature ... Search ... Chat ... Agents ... Pages and Notebooks ... Create ... Copilot key

claims.claim: The Notebook policy is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization ... Select Policy Management ... Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one ... Choose the scope ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented API automation for the Notebook creation and viewing control.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. ... Controls whether users can create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with graph call 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta&preserve-view=true'. Add note: 'Preview applyOnce mode applies a baseline resource microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1, with properties.value "0" to disable or "1" to enable. Supported only for tenant-level policies; fails if the setting is configured in any group-level policy. Requires delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for the calling app, CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for the TCM service principal, and AI Administrator for the signed-in user.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-remediation-applyonce-resources. Retain the group-capable UI and state that this API is tenant-only.
